use: Review Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts for resource limits, security context, probes, rollouts and secrets handling. Use when workloads are added or changed.

steps.note: Read the manifests. Open the Deployments, Services, Ingress, RBAC and Helm values, and list each workload.
Check resources. Each container needs CPU and memory requests and limits.
Check security context. Flag containers that run as root, allow privilege escalation, or mount the host filesystem.
Check probes and rollouts. Each workload needs readiness and liveness probes, and a rollout strategy that does not stop all replicas.
Check secrets and RBAC. Flag secrets in plain manifests, and roles with wildcard permissions.
Report. List each finding as file and resource, with severity and the fix.
